descriptions.text: Prism Industries Capacitating and Focusing Goggles. Special High-Fashion Edition. "The Princess Donut." This is a Unique Item. This one-of-a-kind item was a gift from Princess D'Nadia of the Prism Kingdom to Princess Donut of the Blood Sultanate. It was personally signed by Princess D'Nadia. Protects the eyes from a variety of environmental hazards, including magic-based attacks that render the user blind. Enhances all dark vision effects. Allows for heat vision and other visible-light viewing options. In addition, any energy-based spell that originates from the ocular region is caught and focused by these goggles, which allows for multiple combat and targeting options.

beats.headline: Super sunglasses
beats.text: Back on the platform, Carl notices Donut's new look at once: large round sunglasses that make her look like a bug, like the movie-star pair Bea wears on her head in Donut's photograph. The frames have no arms and her nose is too squished to hold them, yet they stay plastered to her face. They are not just couture, she says. Carl reads the description twice. They turn her Magic Missile into a laser, and she can shoot four at once; standing at the back of the Mauve Platform, she has been firing into four train doors at a time. They can even hold one shot's energy and add it to the next.

beats.headline: An empty box, an upgrade
beats.text: Donut's benefactor box arrived empty, and she is still a little salty about it, though a notification followed: her sunglasses have received an update that reads the surface and subsurface temperature of anything she looks at, in precise detail. Mordecai says that is a common tactic. Exceptional items cost a fortune to send, so a benefactor sends an item on one floor and an upgrade for it on the next, and the next, until it would be worth a Legendary box. The intended purpose is rooting out changelings. Carl sees dozens more, weak spots on mobs, traps, secret doors, temperature warnings. Donut has little patience for any of it.

beats.headline: Locked to the princess
beats.text: Most of what the hunters leave behind is restricted to the dead hunter: Florin has two Goriffs' pulse rifles and electric body armour and cannot equip any of it. Donut's sunglasses turn out to carry the same restriction, which they learned when Louis tried to put them on. Mordecai says it is a common addition to benefactor gifts, to keep other players from murdering the recipient for the gear. A rare scroll called Cracker Jack could free an item, but nobody they know has one. In the meantime they collect all the gear they can.

beats.headline: A magic river under the door
beats.text: Nobody can find the rings on the map. Florin passes on what Lucia worked out: the system counts them as magical gates, so anything that sees magic will spot them. Your sunglasses have a magical-flow setting, Carl tells Donut. They drive off the bed and squeeze under the door into the hallway, and Donut points left, her sunglasses flashing purple. It is that way, under that door, she says; it looks like a magic river flowing toward it. The map says it is a bathroom.
